question: Who is considered as the ‘linchpin of the Government’?

options.text: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court

solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Prime Minister** is considered the 'linchpin of the Government'.
 
• The Prime Minister is the head of the government and is responsible for running the government and implementing laws.
 
• The Prime Minister leads the executive branch of the government and is the chief advisor to the President.
 
• The Prime Minister plays a crucial role in formulating and executing government policies and decisions.
 
• As the leader of the majority party in the Parliament, the Prime Minister ensures the stability and functionality of the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Prime Minister** is appointed by the President of India.
 
• The Prime Minister is the head of the Council of Ministers and presides over cabinet meetings.
 
• The Prime Minister represents the country in various international platforms and negotiations.
 
• In case of a coalition government, the Prime Minister is usually the leader of the largest party in the coalition.
 
• The Prime Minister plays a key role in the appointment of various constitutional and statutory bodies.
 
• The Prime Minister's Office (PMO) is an important part of the government machinery, assisting the Prime Minister in various functions.
 
• The Prime Minister can also recommend the dissolution of the Lok Sabha to the President.
